name: SDF15 field (Hubble)
blurb: A deep field in the Subaru Deep Field toward several of the most distant known galaxies, seen by Hubble.
label: sdf15-hubble
story: This patch of the Subaru Deep Field was chosen because a single Hubble view could hold several of the most distant galaxies whose distances have been confirmed by spectra. Hubble's near-infrared images were meant to reveal the young stars in these faint, remote galaxies.

claims.text: SDF15 is a pointing of Hubble program 12616, near-infrared imaging of the most distant spectroscopically confirmed galaxies in the Subaru Deep Field
The program's near-infrared data measure the properties of young stellar populations
Each WFC3 pointing was chosen to cover several (at least 3, up to 5) spectroscopically confirmed galaxies
